Petitioner :- Vaibhav Sharma
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Rajesh Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Respondent :- Jagdish Prasad Mishra,G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Rajesh Kr. Tiwari, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Jagdish Prasad Mishra, learned
counsel for the informant and Sri Ghanshyam Kumar, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State
respondents.

2.  This writ petition has been filed praying to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 12.7.2024, registered as Case Crime No. 537 of 2024, under Sections 408, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C.,
P.S. Bisrakh, District Gautam Budh Nagar.

sentences.text: 3. Vide order dated 4.9.2024, the matter was referred to the mediation centre.

4. Perused the mediation report as well as the settlement agreement dated 8.9.2024 which indicates that matter has been peacefully settled between the parties and they have settled their differences on the terms mentioned in paragraph No. 7 of the settlement agreement dated 8.9.2024 The paragraph 7 is quoted as under:-
"7.The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
a) That the parties have already settled their dispute and in this regard they have produced the copy of 'Settlement Deed' dated 12.08.2024 which is annexed to this Settlement Agreement for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.
The parties reiterate and reaffirm all the terms and conditions of the aforesaid 'Settlement Deed' dated 12.08.2024 and the same shall be a part of this settlement also.
The parties further stated that the aforesaid 'Settlement Deed' dated 12.08.2024 on notary affidavit in original has already been submitted before the Hon'ble Court.

b) That both the parties have settled their dispute and both the parties do not want to proceed with any civil or criminal proceedings or any other cases in any other court or forum against each other

. After this settlement-agreement the respondent no. 4 does not want to proceed for further legal action in Case Crime No. 0537/2024, u/s 408, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, P.S. Bishrakh, District- Commissionerate Gautambudh Nagar (U.P.) against the petitioner- Vaibhav Sharma.

c) That the petitioner- Vaibhav Sharma has already returned the amount with cost to the tune of Rs. 20 lacs to the respondent no. 4 on 12.08.2024 through RTGS Ref No.
PUNBR52024081211420839 Saving Account No. 59119868166600 HDFC Bank,
Kandivali Mumbai of the respondent no. 4 and the respondent no. 4 has acknowledged the receipt of the same.

d) That it has also been agreed between the parties that all civil and criminal cases (if any) filed by them against each other regarding present dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by taking appropriate steps before the Court/authority concerned.
e) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other in respect of this dispute
It is submitted that as between the parties compromise has already taken place, therefore, the impugned First Information Report is liable to be quashed.

6. Thus, in view of the well settled principles of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court reported in 2003(4) SCC 675 (B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana), J.T. 2008(9) SC 192 (Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of investigation and another), (2012) 10 SCC 303 (Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab),
Vaibhav Sharma vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106006179/
2 (2014) 9 SCC 653 (Yogendra Yadav and others Vs. State of Jharkhand) and also (2014) 6 SCC 466 (Narendra Singh Vs. State of Punjab), and in view of the settlement agreement dated 8.9.2024, the First Information Report dated 12.7.2024, registered as Case Crime No. 537 of 2024, under Sections 408, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., P.S. Bisrakh, District Gautam Budh Nagar, is hereby quashed.
